name: Tater Roku TV
author: heapsoftware
description: Voice control for Roku TVs (ECP) plus a YouTube launcher, with per-satellite TV routing.

verbas.name: Roku TV
verbas.description: Control Roku TVs over the network (playback, volume, mute, HDMI input, power, navigation) and launch YouTube. Each TV profile links to a satellite so a request only reaches that TV.
